modules.title: 检查结果怎样变成合并条件

items.title: 先约定标准，再接入阻断
items.text: 团队根据项目风险设置标准，例如关键测试通过、无严重安全问题。{c:ci} 运行检查；把门禁结果设为分支保护中的必需检查，才能自动拦住未达标的合并。

items.title: 失败后改哪里，要看报告
items.text: 覆盖率不足就检查未覆盖路径，测试失败就查看实际结果与预期的差异。重复运行相同代码或降低标准，不能证明原来的问题已经解决。

modules.title: 这仍然不保证什么
modules.text: 通过只说明已配置的检查满足标准，不代表没有缺陷。只安装扫描工具不会自动锁住合并按钮；发布门禁也需要接入实际发布流程。

lessonPractice.title: PR 的 45 个测试都通过，但报告显示覆盖率 68%，要求至少 80%。下一步怎样做？

options.label: 根据报告补上未覆盖路径的测试，再检查新结果
options.feedback: 失败的是覆盖率条件。补测并重新验证，才能证明这次改动满足约定标准。

options.label: 保持代码和测试不变，再运行一次相同检查
options.feedback: 相同测试重复通过，不会自动覆盖原本没有运行的路径。

options.label: 把阈值从 80% 调到 60%，再检查是否通过
options.feedback: 这样改变了准入标准，并未补上报告指出的测试缺口。

en.title: All 45 PR tests pass, but coverage is 68% against a required 80%. What should happen next?

options.label: Add tests for the uncovered paths, then check the new result
options.feedback: Coverage is the failed condition. Adding tests and verifying again shows whether the agreed criteria are met.

options.label: Rerun the same checks without changing the code or tests
options.feedback: Repeating the same tests does not automatically exercise missing paths.

options.label: Lower the threshold to 60%, then check whether it passes
options.feedback: This changes the admission rule without covering the gap identified in the report.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个 PR 的质量门禁没通过。请查看失败报告，定位缺失的测试或代码问题，修复后重新检查，确认原来的门禁标准已经满足。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This PR failed its quality gate. Inspect the report, fix the missing tests or code issue, rerun the checks, and verify that the original gate criteria are satisfied.

learning.assumes: Know that code changes can trigger automated checks.
learning.outcome: Explain a blocked change using its failed metric and agreed threshold, then request a fix and verification.

items.title: Agree on criteria, then enforce them
items.text: Set criteria according to project risk, such as passing critical tests and no severe security findings. {c:ci} runs checks; require the gate result in branch protection to block changes that fail.

items.title: Use the failure report to choose a fix
items.text: For low coverage, inspect untested paths; for failing tests, compare actual and expected results. Rerunning unchanged code or lowering the threshold does not prove that the original problem was fixed.

modules.title: What this does not guarantee
modules.text: Passing means the configured criteria were met, not that the software is defect-free. Installing a scanner alone does not block merges; deployment gates must likewise be connected to the release flow.

distinctions.label: Feature Flag
distinctions.text: {c:feature-flag} dynamically enables or disables features at runtime based on user or tenant identity; {c:quality-gate} uses automated tests during development to stop broken builds before production.

distinctions.label: CI
distinctions.text: {c:ci} is the automated pipeline workflow that clones repositories and runs test scripts; {c:quality-gate} is the rule set deciding whether results qualify for approval or immediate blocking.
